name: dsh-composer-assist

one_liner.zh: 为 DSH 输入框预测、补全和润色消息草稿。
one_liner.en: Predicts, completes, and polishes message drafts in the DSH composer.

local: Uses the host session model route or a model selected in plugin settings.

config_items.name: DSH_HOME
config_items.description: Overrides the DSH home directory used for the settings file.

config_items.name: HOME
config_items.description: Fallback base directory for settings when DSH_HOME is unset.

readme_mismatch: README describes the v0.1.1 feature set and explicitly says automatic continuation, dynamic workflows, monitoring, roles, and newer decision features are still in development and excluded from the public bundle.

completeness.reason: Implements prediction, completion, polishing, settings, per-session state, and stale-result handling; no broader workflow features are included.

code.reason: Host and browser responsibilities are separated, with bounded context, validation, cancellation, and stale-response checks.

docs.reason: README covers features, installation, settings, model calls, context scope, and self-check usage in Chinese and English.

maintenance.reason: The list records 15 commits and a push on 2026-11-03, four days before this analysis.

tests.reason: A self-check file exists for parser, counters, and context fallback, but no CI or test files are recorded.

quality.notes: Scores use the fixed repository snapshot and its extracted maintenance metadata.
